data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 193.5m (2017: GBP 140.2m) is an improvement of GBP 9.6m (2017: deterioration of GBP 19.1m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments across the significant classes.
data.standardized_narrative: On a gross basis the syndicate experienced an overall adverse reestimation of prior underwriting years (<=2016) of approximately GBP 48.4m (c.12.6% of opening gross claims outstanding). This gross strengthening was concentrated in several pre2017 underwriting years (2014-2016) as shown in the gross claims development table. The managing agent reports a net improvement of GBP 9.6m (net of reinsurance) to prior year reserves driven by favourable developments across significant classes, indicating that increased gross estimates were substantially offset by reinsurance recoveries and other net effects.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 193.5m (2017: GBP 140.2m) is an improvement of GBP 9.6m (2017: deterioration of GBP 19.1m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments across the significant classes.

This follows lower exposure to catastrophe losses in 2018 and is testament to the significant work undertaken over the past 2 years in re-underwriting the portfolio and more recently selectively renewing the business transferred from Syndicates 5820 and 1206.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to Property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development was calculated from the report's gross claims development triangle (page 36) by comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2011-2016. The managing agent text reports a NET improvement of GBP 9.6m (quoted verbatim above); that net figure differs from the gross deterioration calculated here, indicating significant offsetting reinsurance recoveries. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line was provided; therefore the triangle method was used (per instructions). RITC activity is mentioned elsewhere in the report (reinsurance to close of 2016 & prior transferred to Syndicate 2008) which can distort comparisons, but no explicit RITC line was present in the gross triangle to invalidate the calculation. Loblevel prior year movements are not disclosed, so perLOB amounts are null.
